title: Noisy Sensor Homeostasis
limitations: All sensors observe a single deterministic oscillator model; not three independent physical experiments.
Noiseless full model state used to derive raw residual, with measurement noise added afterward.
Common-root rejection can remove useful information, causing failure. Failure is preserved.
Controller's actual correction expenditure and actuation are synthetic proxies, not energy.
No real nuclear fusion, fundamental forces, quantum spinors or Planck-scale physics.
